name: playwright-indonesian-proxy-scraper
description: Python Playwright scraper with rotating Indonesian proxies from free sources (live-verified against Cloudflare-protected putusan3.mahkamahagung.go.id)

skills.name: Python Playwright Expert
skills.description: Best practices for Playwright Python: browser contexts, proxy configuration, stealth, error handling, concurrent scraping

skills.name: Proxy Rotation & Validation
skills.description: Fetching, validating, and rotating free proxies with health tracking, geo-filtering (Indonesia), and failure recovery

skills.name: Async Python Patterns
skills.description: asyncio, aiohttp, concurrent browser contexts, semaphore-based concurrency control, graceful shutdown

skills.name: Ethical Scraping Practices
skills.description: Rate limiting, robots.txt compliance, randomized delays, user-agent rotation, request header variation

explorer.description: Fast codebase exploration: find files, search patterns, understand structure

implementer.description: Implements features: proxy fetching, validation, rotation, Playwright visitor logic

tester.description: Writes and runs tests: unit tests for proxy logic, integration tests for scraper
instructions: Test proxy validator with mock responses

debugger.description: Diagnoses issues: proxy failures, Playwright timeouts, SSL errors, IP leakage
instructions: Run headed browser for visual debugging

setup.command: pip install -r requirements.txt && playwright install chromium

save-pool.description: Fetch, validate, and snapshot the proxy pool to data/pools/proxy_pool.txt (slow, network)

load-pool.description: Inspect the pool restored from data/pools/proxy_pool.txt (no network)

fast-test.description: Scrape using the saved pool snapshot — no network refresh (instant)

dev.description: Run scraper in headed mode for debugging

state.description: Show the current project state snapshot (docs/STATE.md)
